Rainer Maria Rilke.note: Born in Prague, now Czechia; later worked in several European countries.

Jan Potocki.note: Born in Pików (modern Pykiv, Ukraine), in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. His Polish literary identity is separate from the modern location of his birthplace.

Emma Goldman.note: Born in Kaunas, now Lithuania; the Russian Empire is not equivalent to modern Russia.

Sigmund Freud.note: Born in Freiberg in Moravia (modern Příbor, Czechia); later based in Vienna and London.

Flavius Josephus.note: Born in Jerusalem, Roman Judaea; later lived and wrote in Rome. Modern map association is geographic and does not imply ancient nationality.

George Orwell.note: Born at Motihari, Bihar, in present-day India; British literary identity and later career are separate associations.

Rudyard Kipling.note: Born in Bombay (Mumbai), present-day India; later worked in Britain and elsewhere.

Franz Kafka.note: Born in Prague, now Czechia. Austria-Hungary must not be mapped to Austria and Hungary as his birthplace.

Heraclitus.note: From Ephesus, now near Selçuk in Turkey; a Greek philosopher, not born in modern Iran because Ephesus was under Persian rule.

Ammianus Marcellinus.note: Traditionally associated with Antioch (Antakya, Turkey); birthplace is uncertain. Roman Syria is not modern Syria.

Eusebius.note: Associated with Caesarea Maritima, now Israel; exact birthplace is uncertain. Syria Palaestina is not modern Syria.

Lucian.note: Born at Samosata, now in Turkey; Roman Syria is not equivalent to modern Syria.

Benjamin Franklin.note: Born in Boston, now the United States; English America does not locate Boston in Britain.

José Martí.note: Born in Havana, Cuba, then a Spanish colony.

Richard E. Kim.note: Born at Hamhung, now North Korea, then under Japanese colonial rule; later a US writer.

Zitkala-Ša.note: Born on the Yankton Indian Reservation in present-day South Dakota, United States. Indian Reservation does not mean India.

Roger Lancelyn Green.note: Born in Norwich, England. A linked historical United Kingdom title does not establish Irish origin.

Italo Calvino.note: Born at Santiago de Las Vegas, Cuba; raised and worked in Italy.

Joseph Conrad.note: Born at Berdychiv, now Ukraine; Polish background and British literary career are additional associations.

Mikhail Bulgakov.note: Born in Kyiv, now Ukraine; later worked in Russia.

E. T. A. Hoffmann.note: Born in Königsberg, now Kaliningrad, Russia; German language and Prussian identity are distinct from the modern location.

Justinian.note: Traditionally born at Tauresium, near modern Skopje, North Macedonia; later based in Constantinople. Birthplace identification is approximate.

Apollonius of Rhodes.note: Traditionally born in Alexandria or Naucratis, Egypt; later associated with Rhodes.

Arrian.note: Born in Nicomedia, modern İzmit, Turkey; a Greek-speaking Roman author.

Epictetus.note: Traditionally born at Hierapolis, near Pamukkale in modern Turkey; later taught in Greece.

Cassius Dio.note: Born in Nicaea, modern İznik, Turkey; Roman political career.

Procopius.note: From Caesarea Maritima, now Israel; later worked in Constantinople.

Philostratus.note: Traditionally associated with Lemnos, Greece; later worked in Rome. Exact birthplace is uncertain.

Gottfried von Strassburg.note: Associated with Strasbourg, now France; German literary tradition. Biography is uncertain.

María Amparo Ruíz de Burton.note: Born in Loreto, Baja California, now Mexico; later wrote in the United States.

Mary Prince.note: Born in Bermuda; later lived in Britain.

Adalbert Stifter.note: Born in Oberplan (Horní Planá), now Czechia; Austrian literary career.

Karel Čapek.note: Born at Malé Svatoňovice, now Czechia.

Christine de Pizan.note: Born in Venice; raised and wrote in France.

Joshua Slocum.note: Born at Mount Hanley, Nova Scotia, now Canada; later a US citizen.

Marcus Aurelius.note: Born in Rome; the Danube campaign locations associated with Meditations are not his origin.

Aristotle.note: Born in Stagira, now Greece; later taught in Athens and elsewhere.

Herodotus.note: Born in Halicarnassus, modern Bodrum, Turkey; Greek literary identity is separate from the modern location.

Karl Marx.note: Born in Trier, now Germany; later lived in Paris, Brussels and London.

Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels.note: Both authors were born in present-day Germany: Marx in Trier and Engels in Barmen. Brussels was a later work location.

Friedrich Engels.note: Born in Barmen, now Wuppertal, Germany; later worked in Britain.

Friedrich Nietzsche.note: Born in Röcken, now Germany; later taught in Basel, Switzerland.

Hannah Arendt.note: Born in Linden, now Hanover, Germany; later lived in France and the United States. Königsberg childhood is a modern Russian association, not her birthplace.

Thomas Mann.note: Born in Lübeck, Germany; later lived in Switzerland and the United States.

Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel.note: Born in Stuttgart, now Germany; later worked in Bern, Switzerland, and German cities.

Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.note: Born in Salzburg, now Austria; Prague was a later performance and work location.

Alexander von Humboldt.note: Born in Berlin, now Germany; later worked in Paris and travelled widely.

Albert Einstein.note: Born in Ulm, Germany; later worked in Switzerland, Prague and the United States.

Sybille Bedford.note: Born in Charlottenburg, Berlin, Germany; later based in Britain.

Thomas Jefferson.note: Born at Shadwell, Virginia, now the United States; Paris was a later diplomatic posting.

Dante Alighieri.note: Born in Florence, now Italy; French links do not define his origin.

Benvenuto Cellini.note: Born in Florence, now Italy; later worked in France.

Ignatius of Loyola.note: Born at Loyola near Azpeitia, now Spain; later worked in Rome.

Carlos Bulosan.note: Born at Binalonan, Pangasinan, Philippines; later wrote in the United States.

Johann Peter Hebel.note: Born in Basel, Switzerland; later worked in Baden, Germany.

Terence.note: Traditionally born in Carthage, now Tunisia; enslaved and later a playwright in Rome. Biographical details are uncertain.

Olaudah Equiano.note: His autobiography identifies an Igbo birthplace in present-day Nigeria. Some surviving records instead suggest South Carolina; the map follows his own account, not a settled birthplace.

Phillis Wheatley.note: Born in West Africa, possibly present-day Senegal or Gambia; the exact birthplace is unknown. These regions are an approximate source-region range, not a verified country. Later wrote in Boston.

Gabriel García Márquez.note: Born in Aracataca, Colombia; later lived and wrote in Mexico.

Nancy Mitford.note: Born in London, England; later lived in France.

Apuleius.note: Born at Madaura, modern Mdaourouch in Algeria.

Boethius.note: Roman author, born and active in Italy.

Lucretius.note: Exact birthplace is unknown; the Roman author's Italian literary context is the fallback.

Plautus.note: Born at Sarsina in modern Italy.

Sallust.note: Born at Amiternum in modern Italy.

Quintus Curtius Rufus.note: The author's biography is uncertain; Roman literary context is used as the regional fallback.

Tacitus.note: Birthplace is disputed; documented Roman career supplies the Italian association.

Gregory of Tours.note: Born at Clermont and active in Tours, both in modern France.

Michael Psellus.note: Born and active in Constantinople, modern Istanbul, Turkey.

Beroul.note: Probable Norman/Old French literary origin; exact biography is uncertain.

Farid Ud-Din Attar.note: Associated with Nishapur in modern Iran.

Usama ibn Munqidh.note: Born at Shaizar in modern Syria.

Rumi.note: Birth is associated with Wakhsh in modern Tajikistan or traditionally Balkh in Afghanistan; later lived in Konya, Turkey. Both disputed birth traditions are represented.

Black Hawk.note: From the Sauk settlement of Saukenuk in present-day Illinois, United States.

Philippe de Commynes.note: Born at Renescure, now in France, and active at the French court; historical Flanders is not treated as modern Belgium.

Aesop.note: Traditional Greek/Phrygian association, represented by modern Greece and Turkey; historicity and birthplace are uncertain.
